people.name: Lena
observations: Today was Lena's last day at Meridian.
She kept a plant alive for two years at her desk.
She had a mug that said WORLD'S OKAYEST DESIGNER.
Was walked out to the parking garage with a box of her stuff.
Acted bright and brittle trying not to make her departure a moment.
Said she starts at Northlight next Friday, the 4th.
Said she'll put Jordan's name in for a job at Northlight once she gets settled.
Said Northlight's design team is four people and is hiring.
Said Northlight actually ships things.
Told Jordan they have good enough experience, citing the dashboard rebuild.
Said she's not doing Jordan a favor, she's telling Ana about someone good.
Was the only person Jordan could exchange a meaningful look with during a bad meeting.

people.name: Marcus
observations: Said "we'll miss you" to Lena in the same voice he uses to accept a meeting invite.

people.name: Ana
observations: Lena said she would tell Ana about Jordan as someone good for the design team.

projects.name: Dashboard rebuild
observations: Jordan rebuilt the dashboard three times while a manager gave opposite feedback each round.
It shipped and people use it.
Jordan had written on the 20th that the dashboard work was good.

places.name: Meridian
observations: Lena's last day of work was at Meridian.
A sheet cake send-off was held in the kitchen there.
There is a parking garage at Meridian.

places.name: Northlight
observations: Lena starts working there next Friday, the 4th.
Its design team has four people and is hiring.
It actually ships things.
